source_text: Systematic reviews of infant circumcision corroborate net preventive utility against urinary tract infections (reducing risk by up to 90% in the first year), balanitis, and invasive penile cancer (lifetime risk lowered 3- to 22-fold), with procedure-related adverse events occurring in 0.2-0.6% of cases, mostly resolving without sequelae.
